decisions.reason: Three Meta model HTTP 403 responses are model access failures; resume only previously unattempted models, without retrying any inference request. Provider-wide pause applies to repeated 401, 402 or 429 responses.

diagnostics.purpose: One manual diagnostic to classify the earlier HTTP 400 after adding safe error categorization; no automatic retry

openrouterDailySnapshot.scope: Whole API key, UTC day; includes other activity and is not an invoice or per-run reconciliation

billingNotes.limitation: Token estimates exclude provider-internal search/reasoning charges. Perplexity models were attempted before this gap was identified; three completed responses expose costs, one response and one cancellation lack cost evidence. Future built-in research/search models require separately bounded fee accounting. Failed/unknown requests retain their reservations; billing is not reconciled.

provenance.notes: Fixed public toy prompt only. Safe metadata and error codes are retained; raw errors, response text, private paths and credentials are excluded. Previously passed models reference reviewed fixtures; breadth evidence does not replace the four-case release matrix. Incomplete responses retain their reservations and are not model-quality judgments.
